However: BTC still BELOW the $62,000 re-entry gate for the 11th consecutive UTC close. Framework unchanged — flat/cash. ## Technical analysis (Wednesday July 1, 2026 — Full UTC day, Crypto.com MCP confirmed)

**Full UTC day candle:** O$58,627.85 / H$61,327.00 / L$57,802.93 / C$60,029.00. Volume: 3,178 BTC ($190.8M).

**Trend: V-reversal within ongoing distribution.** The morning partial (11:03 UTC) painted a bearish picture: BTC at $58,647, day_winner tentatively 'bears'. The full UTC session reversed completely: BTC dropped to $57,802 (false breakdown below $58,100 structural support), then squeezed short sellers all the way to $61,327 (intraday high), closing at $60,029. This is a +6.1% intraday range and +2.40% on a close basis.

**The false breakdown pattern.** $57,802 breached the $58,100 support that had held for seven sessions (June 25 exact low $58,100.00). In hindsight, the intraday breach was a stop-hunt: weak-hand longs were flushed at $57,802, triggering short momentum, which was then squeezed by the equity market's dual regime gate clearance (SPX >7,460, VIX <17). The false breakdown is a classic distribution-to-reversal pattern — but confirmation requires closing above the prior resistance ($61,000) not just touching it intraday.

**Key resistance: $62,000.** Still the re-entry gate. BTC closed at $60,029, $1,971 below the gate. The intraday $61,327 high shows the market tested above $61,000 but could not sustain. Two consecutive UTC closes above $62,000 are required before re-entry — today is a prerequisite step, not the signal itself.

**Volume: Above average on reversal.** 3,178 BTC ($190.8M) — above the June 30 session (3,776 BTC) but consistent with the distribution-window average. Volume concentration was heaviest during the reversal from $57,802, suggesting genuine short-covering and buy-the-dip demand (not just thin-market drift upward).

**★ Framework status: Flat/cash, monitoring.** The V-reversal is the best setup for re-entry activation in 11 sessions. NFP tomorrow is the binary that determines whether this is a genuine regime change or a false breakout. Protocol unchanged.
